C_COD_REMEDY_IS_DETERMINATE.rationale: The candidate clearly identifies that an unrecognized coupon should not abort the process. It specifies that unrecognised codes contribute zero to the discount (by skipping them using a lookup check), explicitly details how settlement proceeds (settling the order against the remaining discount and recognized coupons, while optionally reporting/logging the unknown code), and provides both the code implementation and expected call outputs.
